# Native build of the C sources generated by TeaVM (gradlew generateC).
# Gradle copies this file into build/generated/teavm/c, next to all.txt.
# Adapted from TeaVM's own test harness (tools/junit/.../teavm-CMakeLists.txt).

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)

# Release by default. This must come before project(): with MSVC, project()
# itself sets CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE to Debug when it is empty.
if (NOT DEFINED CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE OR CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE STREQUAL "")
	set(CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE Release CACHE STRING "Build type")
endif()

project(plantuml_c C)

set(CMAKE_C_STANDARD 11)
set(CMAKE_RUNTIME_OUTPUT_DIRECTORY ${CMAKE_SOURCE_DIR}/bin)

if (MSVC)
	# TeaVM's runtime detects Windows through _MSC_VER: use MSVC or clang-cl.
	# A GNU-style clang/gcc on Windows defines __GNUC__ and takes the POSIX path.
	add_compile_options(/utf-8 /bigobj /W0)
	# One cl.exe per core for the hundreds of generated .c files of the single
	# executable (MSBuild's own parallelism only works between projects).
	if (NOT CMAKE_C_COMPILER_ID STREQUAL "Clang")
		add_compile_options(/MP)
	endif()
else()
	set(CMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE "${CMAKE_C_FLAGS_RELEASE} -O2")
	add_compile_options(-w)
endif()
if (APPLE)
	add_compile_definitions(_DARWIN_C_SOURCE)
endif()

# all.txt lists every generated .c file (all.c is the same set as a single unit)
set_property(DIRECTORY APPEND PROPERTY CMAKE_CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/all.txt)
file(STRINGS ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/all.txt TEAVM_GEN_FILE_LIST)

# Some generated files have the same name once the case is ignored (Boolean.c and
# boolean.c, the two Command.c...). The Visual Studio generator gives each of them its
# own ObjectFileName, and MSBuild then runs one cl.exe per such file, one after the
# other, without /MP (80 files: about 2 minutes 40 on 12 cores). So the files are dealt
# into groups in which no name is used twice; a group is an object library, compiled
# in parallel, and its files need no ObjectFileName.
set(TEAVM_GEN_GROUPS 1)
foreach(F IN LISTS TEAVM_GEN_FILE_LIST)
	if (F STREQUAL "")
		continue()
	endif()
	get_filename_component(NAME "${F}" NAME)
	string(TOLOWER "${NAME}" KEY)
	set(G 1)
	while (TRUE)
		list(FIND TEAVM_GEN_KEYS_${G} "${KEY}" FOUND)
		if (FOUND EQUAL -1)
			break()
		endif()
		math(EXPR G "${G} + 1")
	endwhile()
	list(APPEND TEAVM_GEN_KEYS_${G} "${KEY}")
	list(APPEND TEAVM_GEN_SOURCES_${G} "${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/${F}")
	if (G GREATER TEAVM_GEN_GROUPS)
		set(TEAVM_GEN_GROUPS ${G})
	endif()
endforeach()

# PNG output: plutovg (vendored, static) for rasterisation, a C facade called
# from Java through TeaVM's @Import, and the fonts embedded in the executable.
# Gradle copies src/teavm-c/native into native/ next to this file.
set(BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF)
set(PLUTOVG_BUILD_EXAMPLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
# Only the embedded fonts: never load system fonts, the output must not depend on the machine
set(PLUTOVG_DISABLE_FONT_FACE_CACHE_LOAD ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(native/plutovg)

include(native/embed_font.cmake)
set(FONT_SOURCES)
foreach(STYLE regular bold italic bold_italic)
	# regular -> Regular, bold_italic -> BoldItalic (names of the TTF files)
	string(REPLACE "_" ";" WORDS ${STYLE})
	set(FILE_STYLE "")
	foreach(WORD IN LISTS WORDS)
		string(SUBSTRING ${WORD} 0 1 FIRST)
		string(TOUPPER ${FIRST} FIRST)
		string(SUBSTRING ${WORD} 1 -1 REST)
		string(APPEND FILE_STYLE ${FIRST}${REST})
	endforeach()
	set(OUTPUT ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/font_liberation_sans_${STYLE}.c)
	plantuml_embed_file(${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/native/fonts/LiberationSans-${FILE_STYLE}.ttf ${OUTPUT}
		plantuml_font_liberation_sans_${STYLE})
	list(APPEND FONT_SOURCES ${OUTPUT})
endforeach()

# Files embedded in the executable (themes), found by Java through
# plantuml_resources.c. Gradle copies them from src/main/resources into
# native/resources, and the names below are their paths under src/main/resources.
include(native/embed_resources.cmake)
file(GLOB THEME_FILES CONFIGURE_DEPENDS ${PROJECT_SOURCE_DIR}/native/resources/themes/*.puml)
set(RESOURCE_PAIRS)
foreach(THEME_FILE IN LISTS THEME_FILES)
	get_filename_component(THEME_NAME ${THEME_FILE} NAME)
	list(APPEND RESOURCE_PAIRS "themes/${THEME_NAME}=${THEME_FILE}")
endforeach()
set(RESOURCES_SOURCE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/embedded_resources.c)
plantuml_embed_resources(${RESOURCES_SOURCE} ${RESOURCE_PAIRS})

# miniz (vendored amalgamation, MIT): deflate of the PNG encoder only
add_library(miniz STATIC native/miniz/miniz.c)
target_include_directories(miniz PUBLIC native/miniz)
target_compile_definitions(miniz PUBLIC MINIZ_NO_STDIO MINIZ_NO_TIME MINIZ_NO_ARCHIVE_APIS
	MINIZ_NO_ZLIB_COMPATIBLE_NAMES)

set(TEAVM_GEN_OBJECTS)
foreach(G RANGE 1 ${TEAVM_GEN_GROUPS})
	add_library(plantuml_gen_${G} OBJECT ${TEAVM_GEN_SOURCES_${G}})
	# The generated C includes "plantuml_canvas.h" (@Include of NativeCanvas)
	target_include_directories(plantuml_gen_${G} PRIVATE native)
	list(APPEND TEAVM_GEN_OBJECTS $<TARGET_OBJECTS:plantuml_gen_${G}>)
endforeach()
message(STATUS "Generated C: ${TEAVM_GEN_GROUPS} groups of files with distinct names")

add_executable(plantuml ${TEAVM_GEN_OBJECTS} native/plantuml_canvas.c native/plantuml_png.c native/plantuml_resources.c
	${RESOURCES_SOURCE} ${FONT_SOURCES})
target_include_directories(plantuml PRIVATE native)

if (WIN32)
	target_link_libraries(plantuml plutovg miniz)
elseif (APPLE)
	target_link_libraries(plantuml plutovg miniz m)
else()
	target_link_libraries(plantuml plutovg miniz m rt)
endif()
